title: Polynomial output-length bound
statement: Let $f$ map finite bit strings to finite bit strings, and let $C,c$ be natural numbers. If every bit string $x$ satisfies $|f(x)|\le C(|x|+1)^c$, then for every bit string $w$, the output of the following partial decoding and transformation has length at most $(2C+3)(|w|+1)^{c+1}$: parse $w$ as a pair $(x,b)$; if parsing succeeds and $b$ is the binary expansion of its value, return the encoding of $(f(x),b)$, and otherwise return the empty string.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from bit strings to bit strings
